examPattern: Mid-Sem: 2 Hours (30 Marks) | End-Sem: 3 Hours (50 Marks) | Continuous Evaluation: 20 Marks

units.title: Vector Spaces and Subspaces
topics: Definition of Fields, Field Axioms, and Euclidean Spaces
Vector Space Axioms over Real and Complex Fields
Subspaces: 3-Point Subspace Test, Linear Combinations, and Linear Span
Linear Dependence, Linear Independence, and Wronskian / Determinant Criteria
Basis and Dimension: Finite Dimensional Spaces, Extension of Basis, and Dimension Theorems

units.title: Linear Transformations & Matrix Analysis
topics: Linear Transformations, Kernel (Null Space), and Range (Column Space)
Rank-Nullity Theorem and Matrix Representation of Linear Operators
Inner Product Spaces, Cauchy-Schwarz Inequality, and Orthogonality
Orthogonal Projections, Gram-Schmidt Orthogonalization Process, and QR Decomposition
Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors, Diagonalization, and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)

units.title: Two-Dimensional Random Variables & Regression
topics: Joint Probability Mass Functions (PMF) and Joint Probability Density Functions (PDF)
Expectation, Covariance, Correlation Coefficient (Pearson), and Independence
Lines of Regression: Principle of Least Squares and Angle Between Regression Lines
Standard Error of Estimate and Regression Coefficients

textbooks: Gilbert Strang, 'Linear Algebra and Its Applications', 5th Edition, Cengage Learning
Sheldon Ross, 'A First Course in Probability', 10th Edition, Pearson Education
references: David C. Lay, 'Linear Algebra and Its Applications', Pearson
Papoulis & Pillai, 'Probability, Random Variables and Stochastic Processes', McGraw Hill
